turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail:
Most orders are shipped from our warehouse within 1 to 2 business days! Once your order is on its way, you will receive a tracking link via email or SMS. 🙂

It can take up to 3 business days (excluding weekends and holidays) for the tracking information to update after the package has been shipped.

To give you a more specific update on your order, could you please share your order number, email address, or phone number?

turns.q: Once it ships, how long is delivery?
turns.replyTail:
Standard delivery typically takes 3 to 7 business days for orders within the US and Canada! 🙂

For international orders, it can take about 15 to 20 business days from the shipment date to be delivered.

If you can provide your order number, email address, or phone number, I can check the exact status for you!

turns.replyTail:
If your tracking information hasn't updated for more than 3 business days, please let me know! Standard shipping carriers can sometimes take a little time to refresh their systems once the package leaves our warehouse. 🙂

To help you right now, I just need your order number, email address, or phone number. Once I have that, I can look into your shipment details for you!
